doc.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996

title: Studying at Manhattan School of Music
summary: Musicians turned to education after changes in the business; LaPorta earned his degree and substitute taught.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: And you along the way picked up degrees from, was it Manhattan School of Music?
Yeah I went to Manhattan School of Music.

At that point many musicians were starting to feel, because of the changes that had taken place in the business, that they wanted to get into the education part of it. So there were many well known musicians going to school right around the same time. I always sub- taught, I taught as a substitute four days in high school, afterwards. But I’m glad I went through it.
